summary: NaaS Technology Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b)(2) for continued listing. The company previously received a February 17, 2026 deficiency notice for failing to maintain a minimum market value of listed securities of $35 million for 30 consecutive trading days. Nasdaq confirmed compliance after the company's MVLS exceeded $35 million for 20 consecutive business days from July 7 through August 3, 2026. The matter is closed. The event resolves a potential delisting risk and represents an operational milestone for the issuer.
